body.zh: 按战略契合、影响、成本、可逆性等打分，看清该做什么、该停什么。
body.en: Score options on strategy, impact, cost and reversibility to see what to do and what to stop.

question.zh: 帮我比较这些事项，想清楚应该做什么、停什么。
question.en: Help me compare these initiatives and decide what to pursue or stop.

body.zh: 整理对方上次的关切和还没兑现的承诺，排好议程。
body.en: Gather their last concerns and open commitments into an agenda.

prompt.zh: 帮我准备下一次一对一，先看上次的关切和承诺。
prompt.en: Help me prepare my next one-to-one using previous concerns and commitments.

title.en: Set up a Monday decision list

body.zh: 每周一早上列出本周必须做的决定和逾期的承诺。
body.en: Every Monday morning, list this week’s decisions and overdue commitments.
